description: This file defines the EndpointV2Middleware class which is responsible for evaluating endpoint rules and resolving endpoints within the AWS SDK for PHP. It handles middleware creation, endpoint parameter resolution, authentication scheme application, and dependency injection for endpoint-related operations.

classes.name: EndpointV2Middleware
classes.description: Middleware class handling endpoint rule evaluation and endpoint resolution for AWS SDK requests.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Creates a middleware wrapper function that encapsulates endpoint provider, API, arguments, and credential provider to produce middleware handlers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the middleware with handler, endpoint provider, API, arguments, and optional credential provider.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to process a command, resolve endpoint, and apply authentication schemes as needed.

methods.name: resolveArgs
methods.description: Resolves and merges endpoint parameters from client, command, static, and operation contexts for endpoint resolution.

methods.name: filterEndpointCommandArgs
methods.description: Filters command arguments to include only relevant parameters for endpoint resolution based on ruleset parameters.

methods.name: bindStaticContextParams
methods.description: Binds static context parameters to their corresponding values.

methods.name: bindContextParams
methods.description: Binds context parameters to values from command arguments.

methods.name: bindOperationContextParams
methods.description: Binds operation context parameters using a path search in command args.

methods.name: applyAuthScheme
methods.description: Applies the resolved authentication scheme to the command's context.

methods.name: resolveAuthScheme
methods.description: Selects and normalizes the first valid auth scheme supported by the endpoint.

methods.name: normalizeAuthScheme
methods.description: Normalizes an auth scheme details into recognized internal format.

methods.name: isValidAuthScheme
methods.description: Checks if a given auth scheme name is valid and supported, considering external extension availability.

methods.name: resolveAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the AWS account ID if possible, based on credential provider, handling disabled modes.
